notes: Single-file lawn defense, vanilla canvas + WebAudio, no dependencies. Six plant cards (Sunflower, Peashooter, Repeater, Snow Pea, Wall-nut, Cherry Bomb) with cost/cooldown, sun economy (sky + sunflower), five zombie types across ramping waves plus a flag-led FINAL WAVE, per-row lawn mowers as last defense, shovel, pause, win/lose screens, synthesized SFX and bass/drums, and a persistent top-10 leaderboard in localStorage with name entry. Verified headless (Chrome CDP + real UI clicks): full loop from menu through planting, wave spawns, moving zombies, defeat, leaderboard save, replay and pause.
